additional_info.subject: ID0408561 DC/Si-D/AR [MP / P9 170000997] Outlet 3 Out of Order CRM:00251000489
additional_info.body:
Dear Facundo,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Reetesh
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000997
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
qbJssk
Problem Description
: Outlet 3 Out of Order
Warranty Status
: Charger is out of Warranty Since 8 Sep 2024
Current FW Version:
v3.2.8-0-g4104b8b+SF-RETOPICS
Upon checking the charger on SCB, we found the active Error flag
DC_Coils_MG1-MG4_SelfTest
PLC
SYSTEM
true
status: failed, reason: smc-init state failed
This means the switching matric contactor self-test evaluation was failed.
The quality of switching matrix contactors is tested by this functionality, after the reboot or when the Main breaker is turned on/closed in ideal condition.
Either you have a defective contactors QA9-10 or it can be a detection delay. Hence, I would suggest upgrading the charger to latest SW version v6.0.3 before planning a site visit for contactor replacement.
Do you have enough data on the SIM card installed on this charger to perform remote SW update. The update will consume ~7 or 8 GB of data as we need to update from v3.2.8 to v4.0.11 to v5.0.23 before reaching v6.0.3.?
Or you can also do a local onsite update by using USB.
Since the charger is out of warranty the remote technical support on this charger will be limited to an hour.
Please let u know your preferred approach.
For future reference, your case number is
0408561
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
